issues.what: Diagram title 'Service Mesh Architecture' directly reveals the correct answer
issues.detail: The SVG diagram title text reads 'Service Mesh Architecture' and the diagram shows sidecar proxies with mTLS and a Control Plane. The correct answer (option C) is the only option that mentions 'service mesh.' A student can read the diagram title and immediately select option C without any Kubernetes knowledge.
issues.suggestion: Change the diagram title from 'Service Mesh Architecture' to a neutral label such as 'Inter-Service Communication Pattern' or 'Sidecar Proxy Architecture'. This preserves the pedagogical value of the diagram while requiring students to identify the pattern from the architecture shown rather than from the title text.
